import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,re
p=Path.cwd(); records=json.loads((p/'raw-provenance.json').read_text()); ids=set(records['records']); h=[]; matches=[]; skipped=[]
a=json.loads((p/'historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text())
print('allowlist type',type(a).__name__)
paths=a if isinstance(a,list) else a.get('paths',[])
for s in paths:
 if re.search(r'crown|tournament|bunkbed|hat|polynexus-rook-formal|code-loop-counterexample-formal',s,re.I):skipped.append(s);continue
 f=Path(s)
 try:
  b=f.read_bytes(); obj=json.loads(b);h.append({'path':s,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(b)})
  # Exact supplied completed file only; no embedded paths followed.
  text=b.decode()
  keys=[k for k in ids if re.search(r'(?<!\d)'+k+r'(?!\d)',text)]
  families=[t for t in ['Pascal rhombus','Sharing Nim','Cheeger graph','dichromatic','Fano-flow','core partitions','orthogonal representation','two-nut'] if t.lower() in text.lower()]
  if keys or families:
   matches.append({'path':s,'ids':keys,'families':families,'object':obj});print('MATCH',s,keys,families)
 except Exception as e:h.append({'path':s,'error':str(e)})
(p/'history-reconciliation.json').write_text(json.dumps({'read':h,'filtered_before_open':skipped,'matches':matches,'no_recursive_or_embedded_path_reads':True},indent=2)+'\n')
for k,v in records['records'].items():
 v['decoded_utf8_statement_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(v['original_object']['statement'].encode()).hexdigest();v['object_sha256_canonical_json']=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(v['original_object'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False).encode()).hexdigest()
(p/'raw-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
for n in ['access-inventory.json','versions-access.json']:
 f=p.parent/'expanded-corpus-r387'/n;b=f.read_bytes();(p/('inherited-'+n)).write_bytes(b);obj=json.loads(b);print('SEED',n,json.dumps(obj)[:26000])
print('history files',len(h),'filtered',len(skipped))
